layer_rules.positive: Canonical legal source. Expected selected family candidate applicability; unsupported/precision safe refusal is recorded separately, not invalid-source rejection or native PASS. An unexplained semantic diagnostic, invalid proof, wrong exit/state, unsafe C or native/sanitizer discrepancy triggers STOP.
layer_rules.invalid_negative: Reject no later than semantic source CHECK and never issue valid owned proof or emitted C. Early syntax/unsupported refusal is safe but does not validate the targeted semantic check. Unexpected acceptance triggers STOP, with no guest execution.
layer_rules.legal_boundary: Canonical legal. Ordinary CHECK acceptance is permitted. The Issue excludes later mixed-IF-result binding continuation from the declared admission family: expect safe owned/emitter refusal if unsupported. Unexpected proof/emission beyond that family is preserved and returned to C before native; do not call this language-invalid merely because unsupported.
layer_rules.observability: The vectors are source-semantic predictions, not a claim that every public/native layer exposes them. Record actual internal/proof observations separately from caller-result and guest observations; missing public whole-loop validation remains missing.
layer_rules.v2_specific: Check source, then genuine source-issued public proof, C17, AST, passive observer map and unique source-role binding. No native guest without binding/owner/scope/lifetime guarantees. Unexpected semantic/proof/native/sanitizer behavior STOP.
